title: Jukeboxlized Old Bgm
description: 适配数据包的材质包。Jukeboxlized Old Bgm is a resource pack that adapts and integrates classic old Minecraft bgm into the in-game jukebox system.
body:
The newer versions of Minecraft seem to intentionally increase the weight of new background music, making the classic C418 BGM almost impossible to hear in-game (unless using other resource packs). This resourcepack aims to turn all of C418's in-game BGM, including Creative Mode tracks, into music discs, with complete obtaining methods with the help of datapack of the same name:

1. Overworld BGM — Unlit Creeper kills Skeleton
2. Nether BGM — Skeleton shoots Creeper in the Nether
3. Menu BGM — Unlit Creeper kills Baby Zombie
4. Creative Mode BGM — Skeleton kills airborne Creeper
5. Alpha — Ender Dragon kills Creeper
6. The End — Skeleton kills Creeper in the End
7. Under Water BGM — Drowned kills Creeper

新版本的背景音乐似乎总是刻意让新版音乐的权重变高，老的C418bgm游戏内几乎很难听到（除非使用其他材质包）。这个材质包旨在把C418的所有游戏内bgm包括创造模式的唱片化，并且配合同名数据包创建了完善的唱片获取途径：

1. 主世界bgm —— 未被点燃的苦力怕炸死骷髅
2. 地狱bgm —— 地狱中骷髅射杀苦力怕
3. 菜单bgm ——未被点燃的苦力怕炸死小僵尸
4. 创造模式bgm —— 骷髅射杀空中的苦力怕
5. Alpha —— 末影龙杀死苦力怕
6. the_end —— 末地骷髅杀死苦力怕
7. 水下bgm —— 溺尸杀死苦力怕
